items.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Reported a $91M Fuel Surcharge Surplus. Could That Hurt its Norfolk Southern Deal?
items.summary: Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP) reported $91.1 million more in fuel-surcharge revenue than in fuel cost during the second quarter, according to its Surface Transportation Board filing. Management separately attributed $0.14 of EPS, approximately $83.2 million using diluted weighted-average shares, to the net difference between fuel expense and surcharge revenue. items.title: All Aboard: STB Resumes Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger Review
items.summary: The Surface Transportation Board said supplemental information from the railroads was sufficient to restart its review, with a final decision not expected until after May 2027.

items.title: Regulators set schedule for review of UP-NS merger
items.summary: The Surface Transportation Board resumed its review of the Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern merger after lifting a prior delay. The post Regulators set schedule for review of UP-NS merger appeared first on FreightWaves.

items.title: Union Pacific fuel surcharges exceed Q2 fuel costs by $91.1 million
items.summary: Union Pacific (NYSE:UNP) collected $91. 1 million more from fuel surcharges than it spent on fuel during the second quarter, according to a regulatory filing with the Surface Transportation Board first reported by Reuters.

items.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Stock Looks Cheap On Earnings But Fair On Cash Flow
items.summary: Union Pacific stock has delivered a 46.3% total return over the past 5 years, yet current checks point to a company that now looks closer to fairly priced than obviously cheap, with the Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate sitting only slightly above the market price. A 46.3% 5 year return suggests Union Pacific has already rewarded patient shareholders and may now offer a more measured return profile from here.
